scope: Health neutral-selection structured classification evidence paths only

source_boundary.principle: A source is blind-safe because its admissible fields are bounded by construction before selector exposure, not because a parser discards forbidden semantic content afterward.

evidence: IRDAI Non-Life Insurance Products structured register exposes Type Of Product values including Main Product and Add-on
historical IRDAI product lists expose Main product / Add-on alongside UIN
Individual/Health UIN classification does not by itself prove indemnity

explicit Indemnity/Benefit classification has been observed in regulator-hosted filed product documents but those documents are excluded by the C5.24 source boundary unless the classification is available through a structurally bounded metadata artifact
IRDAI structured product registers may expose Individual/Group or Retail/Group style product typing but do not universally expose family-floater availability as a dedicated bounded field
family-floater status is explicitly observable in product documents but those semantic-bearing documents remain outside preselection

structural_ceiling.reason: No necessary predicate has yet been proven to require semantic content in principle; only a universal structurally bounded metadata path has not been demonstrated for benefit_basis and coverage_arrangement.

decision_rule: Do not implement a selector projection or preregister Product #14 until every necessary regulatory/stipulated predicate is either demonstrably establishable through the frozen structured source boundary or the architecture explicitly concludes that a structural ceiling exists.
